sample.negativeControl: ONE original legal 42-ply DRAW, rank-matched odd P1 turns

notes: The 28 target line ID list DOES NOT enter any source formula; only the originally solved game histories are used as post-hoc validation population.
Source E is local direct next-P0-win after ONE P1 move; an unsafe alternate action is not an optimal continuation and E is NOT exact WDL.
Distinct original prefix de-duplication per rank avoids overcounting shared first-five-center historical prefixes.
The negative control is not a random sample of drawing games; no general optimal-game frequency inferred.
External strong-score validity comes from issue41 historic calibration, not newly rerun here.
No other W/H/K geometry tested; no game solver or IsoGraph1.2 mutation.
